segments.name: Industry cloud solutions
segments.description: Provides industry cloud software, data, and business consulting solutions for the global life sciences industry, from R&D through commercialization.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, the Company operates as a single operating and reportable segment that is focused on providing industry cloud solutions tailored to the global life sciences industry.

revenueModel.text: Life sciences companies pay subscription fees for Veeva's cloud software and data solutions and fees for professional services and business consulting.
revenueModel.evidence: We group our revenues into two product areas: Commercial Solutions and R&D and Quality Solutions.
